narrative: Today's KEV story names CVE-2026-48710 as the Starlette host-header bypass that chains the command-injection bug into unauthenticated CVSS 10.0 remote code execution needing no login, key, or prior access. That effective severity sits far above the original 6.5, and the Starlette fix shipping in 1.0.1 shows it scored and remediated as a live high-severity flaw, supporting the expected upward re-score.
remaining_gap: No formal NVD record edit or vendor advisory yet rating CVE-2026-48710 itself above 6.5; today's high severity is the chained pair, not a standalone re-score.
